params.amount: The amount of yield being allocated.

params._debtSubsidizer: The address of the DebtSubsidizer contract.
params._initialAdmin: The initial admin of the contract.
params._initialAutomatedSystem: The address of the automated system that will interact with this contract.
params._initialEpochDuration: The initial duration for epochs (e.g., 7 days in seconds).

emergencyPause().details: Emergency pause - can be called by GUARDIAN_ROLE even when paused

endEpochWithSubsidies(uint256,address,by.details: Combines Merkle root update and epoch finalization for simplified workflow.

params.epochId: The ID of the epoch to end.
params.merkleRoot: The Merkle root for subsidy claims.
params.subsidiesDistributed: The total amount of subsidies distributed.
params.vaultAddress: The address of the vault for which to update the Merkle root.

returns.status: The current status of the epoch.
returns.totalYieldAvailable: Total yield available for the epoch.

returns.status: The current status of the epoch.
returns.totalYieldAvailableInEpoch: Total yield available for the epoch.

returns.status: The current status of the epoch.
returns.totalYieldAvailable: Total yield available for the epoch.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getRoleMember(bytes32,uint256).details: Returns one of the accounts that have `role`. `index` must be a value between 0 and {getRoleMemberCount}, non-inclusive. Role bearers are not sorted in any particular way, and their ordering may change at any point. WARNING: When using {getRoleMember} and {getRoleMemberCount}, make sure you perform all queries on the same block. See the following https://forum.openzeppelin.com/t/iterating-over-elements-on-enumerableset-in-openzeppelin-contracts/2296[forum post] for more information.

getRoleMemberCount(bytes32).details: Returns the number of accounts that have `role`. Can be used together with {getRoleMember} to enumerate all bearers of a role.

getRoleMembers(bytes32).details: Get all role members for a specific role (limited to first 100 for gas efficiency)

returns._0: The amount of yield allocated by the vault for the epoch.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

grantRoleWithDetails(bytes32,address).details: Enhanced role granting with event emission

isAdmin(address).details: Check if an address has admin privileges (any admin role)

markEpochFailed(uint256,string).details: Can only be called by the automated system or owner. This is used to explicitly abort an epoch if issues arise.

params.epochId: The ID of the epoch to mark as failed.
params.reason: A string describing the reason for failure.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRoleWithDetails(bytes32,address).details: Enhanced role revoking with safety checks

params.newAutomatedSystem: The new address for the automated system.

params.newDebtSubsidizer: The new address for the DebtSubsidizer contract.

startEpoch().details: Streamlined version that just starts the epoch and returns the ID.

returns._0: epochId The ID of the newly started epoch.

allocateVaultYield(address,uint256).notice: Allocates yield from a specific vault to the current active epoch.

endEpochWithSubsidies(uint256,address,by.notice: Ends an epoch with subsidies in a single atomic operation.

getCurrentEpochId().notice: Returns the ID of the current epoch. If no epoch has started, returns 0.

getEpoch(uint256).notice: Gets the details of a specific epoch (alternative signature for interface compatibility).

getEpochDetails(uint256).notice: Gets the details of a specific epoch.

getVaultYieldForEpoch(uint256,address).notice: Gets the yield allocated by a specific vault for a given epoch.

setAutomatedSystem(address).notice: Updates the address of the automated system.

setDebtSubsidizer(address).notice: Updates the address of the DebtSubsidizer contract.

startEpoch().notice: Starts a new epoch with simplified interface.
